sceneDescription: On a supermarket checkout conveyor belt, a shiny gold wristwatch rides between a pile of everyday chocolate chip cookies and a small, futuristic toy robot. The watch is on a bright, crinkled bakery bag (with a subtle Modern Retail logo sticker), while the robot perches on a jewelry box with a tiny Jeweller sticker. A discreet Total Retail bag pokes from the cookie pile. The absurdity comes from the luxury watch and robot traveling with mundane snacks, suggesting AI-driven discovery and the blending of luxury and everyday retail. The conveyor is paused mid-motion, as if the items just arrived together by surprise.
